Table "public"."access_logs" {
  "access_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "user_id" INTEGER
  "character_id" INTEGER
  "access_date" TEXT
  "access_type" TEXT
  "ip_address" TEXT
  "user_agent" TEXT
  "duration" TEXT
}

Table "public"."categories" {
  "category_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "name" TEXT
  "description" TEXT
  "created_at" TEXT
  "updated_at" TEXT

  "is_active" INTEGER
}

Table "public"."character_dislikes" {
  "dislike_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "character_id" INTEGER
  "dislike_name" TEXT
  "category_id" INTEGER
  "description" TEXT
  "created_at" TEXT
  "intensity" TEXT
  "frequency" TEXT
}

  "image_id" INTEGER [pk]

}

  "intensity" TEXT
  "frequency" TEXT

}

  "like_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "character_id" INTEGER
  "like_name" TEXT
  "category_id" INTEGER
  "description" TEXT
  "created_at" TEXT
  "intensity" TEXT
  "frequency" TEXT
}

  "appearance_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "character_id" INTEGER
  "media_id" INTEGER
  "appearance_date" TEXT
  "description" TEXT
  "role" TEXT
  "duration" TEXT
  "episode_number" INTEGER
}

  "trait_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "character_id" INTEGER
  "trait_name" TEXT
  "description" TEXT
  "created_at" TEXT

  "frequency" TEXT

}

  "version_id" INTEGER [pk]

}

  "video_id" INTEGER [pk]

  "upload_date" TEXT

}

Table "public"."characters" {
  "character_id" INTEGER [pk]

  "age" INTEGER

  "franchise_id" INTEGER [pk]

  "media_id" INTEGER [pk]

  "user_id" INTEGER [pk]

  "email" TEXT

  "created_at" TEXT
  "updated_at" TEXT
  "phone_number" TEXT
  "address" TEXT

}
